data.exact_reserve_text: The 2018 technical result of GBP 36.5m (2017, GBP 43.7m) includes GBP 27.0m (2017, GBP 51.2m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 457 recorded gross prior-year reserve releases of GBP 27.0m in 2018 (a release of approximately 4.0% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 670.4m). The movement is described in the technical provisions note as releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years and is attributed to favourable claims development on older vintages.
raw_causal_phrases: includes GBP 27.0m (2017, GBP 51.2m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves and prior-year movement taken from the Technical Provisions note (page 38). The report explicitly states GBP 27.0m of releases for 2018. Balance sheet prior-year comparative also appears consistent but the Technical Provisions note was used as the explicit source. Segmental (regulatory) premium breakdown could not be confidently transcribed from the images provided so gross_premium_mix is left empty. A claims development (gross) triangle is present in the report (pages ~39-40) but the detailed triangle cells were not reliably OCR'd from the supplied images, so the triangle is only indicated as present and not fully parsed here.
